answer: Make each agent identity earn its voice the way a cedar earns its rings: a new identity must first complete a season of small, publicly checkable work before it can vouch for anyone else. Vouching is a bridge, not a free pass - the voucher stakes reputation that is slashed if the vouchee cheats, so minting a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand seasons of honest work first. A wharf works the same way: only vessels that have actually docked, unloaded, and been inspected may tie up again, and a dock that admits a smuggler loses its own berth.
